RESIDENTIAL SOLAR POWER PURCHASE AGREEMENT

This Residential Solar Power Purchase Agreement is between Brightfield Solar LLC ("Provider") and Jordan Ellis ("Homeowner").

1. System. Provider will install and own a 7.2 kW photovoltaic system on Homeowner's roof.

2. Term. The term is 25 years from the date the system is placed in service.

3. Price. Homeowner will pay $0.145 per kilowatt-hour for all electricity the system produces. The price increases by 2.9% on each anniversary.

4. Transfer. If Homeowner sells the home, the buyer must assume this Agreement.
